NCT00206232: complete registered planned-outcome listing (7 source records).
1. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Procollagen peptides, troponin I, tumor necrosis factor alpha, Brain Natriuretic Peptide" (type: "other"; time frame: "Baseline then 3 and 6 months after randomization") [cite:0b1654c7b32dcf6c84b359b6].
2. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Electrolytes, blood urea nitrogen, creatinine" (type: "other"; time frame: "Screening and enrollment then 10 days, 4 weeks, 11 weeks, 13 weeks, and 15 weeks after randomization") [cite:7cc2203163d432f20b1f0dc9].
3. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Quality of Life Questionaire" (type: "other"; time frame: "Baseline, then 3 and 6 months after randomization") [cite:c39166004f6b4ec2880630ce].
4. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "New York Heart Association Classification" (type: "other"; time frame: "Baseline then 3 and 6 months after randomization") [cite:afc21d2763ef61bb371ab945].
5. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Number of participants with adverse events" (type: "other"; time frame: "From randomization until trial completion at 6 months.") [cite:7b224cc3bc6196fe295bdb64].
6. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Echocardiography parameters of diastolic function" (type: "secondary"; time frame: "Baseline, then 3 and 6 months after randomization") [cite:5f7801d0898b5b5096a9fef4].
7. For NCT00206232, the registered planned outcome measure is "Six minute walk distance" (type: "primary"; time frame: "Baseline, then 3 and 6 months after randomization") [cite:59a973a72a79cfe5535af0c7].
Registered planned outcomes are not observed clinical results.
